shared_elements: low-relief carving on a large worked stone block
justification: B presents a clearly legible programme — a top register of repeated arched/H-like signs, a horizontal banded frieze with pendant elements, and below it profile quadrupeds, a long-necked bird and other creatures stacked in registers — whereas A shows only an eroded worked block with faint, indeterminate rounded traces and no identifiable creature, sign or register scheme. The only correspondence is the generic fact of shallow relief on a large stone with vague circular marks, which no shared iconographic tradition can be inferred from.
